verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships in-product AI that works on customer data in two narrow places. First Pass AI pre-screens uploaded evidence to catch common rejections before the audit, and GenAI DDQ autofills security questionnaires. The in-app AI Helpbot answers only from Thoropass support and documentation content, not the user's workspace data. The MCP server lets an external assistant query workspace data, but that happens outside the product, not inside it. missing for 10: general in-product AI insights or recommendations across workspace data (controls, risks, monitors), detail on what First Pass AI's feedback or suggestions look like, independent or hands-on corroboration.
